name: Potential WinAPI Calls Via PowerShell Scripts
description: Detects use of WinAPI functions in PowerShell scripts
author: GAI_CTI
query: (powershell.file.script_block_text:*VirtualAlloc* AND powershell.file.script_block_text:*OpenProcess* AND powershell.file.script_block_text:*WriteProcessMemory* AND powershell.file.script_block_text:*CreateRemoteThread*) OR (powershell.file.script_block_text:*OpenProcessToken* AND powershell.file.script_block_text:*LookupPrivilegeValue* AND powershell.file.script_block_text:*AdjustTokenPrivileges*) OR (powershell.file.script_block_text:*OpenProcessToken* AND powershell.file.script_block_text:*DuplicateTokenEx* AND powershell.file.script_block_text:*CloseHandle*) OR (powershell.file.script_block_text:*WriteProcessMemory* AND powershell.file.script_block_text:*VirtualAlloc* AND powershell.file.script_block_text:*ReadProcessMemory* AND powershell.file.script_block_text:*VirtualFree*)
